card.name: Partway through table cells and units
card.fires_on: Word pieces and spaces inside dose and trial tables, such as 'Decre' in 'Decreases' after 'additional cases', the 'mc' of 'mcg', or the gap after a number before a unit.

modes.label: Decre in case-count tables
modes.description: The start of 'Decreases' right after 'additional cases' in a placebo comparison table.

modes.label: Units and spacing in dosing tables
modes.description: The 'mc' of mcg or the blank space after a number in titration or dose-adjustment tables.

modes.label: Linking word before an example
modes.description: The word 'such' before 'as warfarin' in an interaction sentence.
